name: @inneranimalmedia/iamscene
purpose: Portable scene v1 runtime and verified file interchange; experimental IAMScene v2 multi-scene authoring model, independent scene-system records, and migration, with renderer support explicitly separate.
use_when: Authoring and versioning editable scenes and individually addressable geometry assets without losing native source references.
Discovering true per-format import, export, live-reference and round-trip capabilities through createIAMSceneFormatRegistry().
Importing glTF/GLB with source-backed node hierarchy and limited editable material properties, or importing STL/OBJ/PLY triangles into linked .iamgeometry plus GLB representations.
Exporting exact geometry as STEP/BREP and geometric IFC4 through a verified optional OCCT native executable on an authorized host.
Integrating IAMScene scenes into browser/Node editors while preserving imported source files and reporting conversion losses.
Calling the optional hosted CAD building-service adapter to export a bounded cad.project.v2 rectangular shell into verified IFC4/STEP/DXF/SVG/PNG/GLB/PDF/MP4 artifacts, subject to host authorization.
avoid_when: Claiming .blend/.dwg/.usd/.ifc import or other reference-only extensions are semantically editable or exportable without registered and tested adapters.
Treating an integrity-checked live reference as proof of parse, render, edit or semantic round-trip support.
Replacing CAD Creator project authority, OCCT parametric modeling source or CoPro media timeline authority.
Assuming a host has a native OCCT binary, Node.js, Blender or FreeCAD installed without an explicit runtime probe.
Using a flattened GLB as the sole authoritative editable source for a scene or BIM project.
Treating the bounded CAD shell export as complete BIM/IFC import, full DreamHouse coverage or a generally available Cloudflare production worker.
